multi_entity_note: single patient (pregnant woman) case report; fetus mentioned only incidentally

medical.diagnosis.rationale: Definitive histology of the pre-sacral lesion confirmed Schwannoma (WHO grade I); the borderline ovarian tumours are concurrent findings, not the confirmed final diagnosis of the index mass.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: The Schwannoma was treated surgically; NSAIDs were given for leg pain before the diagnosis, not as treatment of the final diagnosis.
